description: Header file defining the cSettings class for managing configuration settings with JSON data, including file I/O operations and key-value management.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: Class for managing configuration settings stored in a JSON object, with methods for reading from and writing to a file, and manipulating key-value pairs.

methods.name: cSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the settings object, creating the file if it does not exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key from the JSON data.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set a key's value with string, int, or bool types, then write to file.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists and is non-empty in the JSON data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the JSON data.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Serializes the JSON data to the file if it exists.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Initializes JSON data from the configuration file.
